content: {"paper_id":"W2905443329","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"Partial label learning aims to learn from training examples each associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one label is valid for the training example.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要首句直接定义偏标记学习：每个训练样本对应候选标签集且仅一个为真，全文以此为核心研究设定。"},{"keyword_id":"label-enhancement","exact_quote":"Partial Label Learning via Label Enhancement","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确以标记增强作为核心方法；摘要进一步说明从偏标记恢复广义标签分布，满足从逻辑标签构建更细致标签分布的定义。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Partial label learning aims to learn from training examples each associated with a set of candidate labels, among which only one label is valid for the training example.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"每个实例只给出候选标签集且仅一个有效，属于以不精确/粗粒度监督替代精确实例级真值，并作为全文实质研究问题。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","reason_zh":"摘要恢复广义标签分布作为中间监督并拟合回归器，但最终学习的是多类预测模型，未明确将预测标签分布本身作为任务，证据不足。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","reason_zh":"仅提到利用特征空间拓扑信息恢复标签分布，未说明使用邻域、图拉普拉斯或流形约束，机制证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
